description: This file contains JavaScript code for the Drupal Layout Builder module, attaching behaviors for filtering, dragging, disabling interactive elements, highlighting, and toggling content previews within the layout editing interface.

methods.name: Drupal.layoutBuilderBlockUpdate
methods.description: Updates the server about the new position of a block after drag-and-drop in the layout.

methods.name: Drupal.theme.layoutBuilderPrependContentPreviewPlaceholderLabel
methods.description: Creates HTML markup for a content preview placeholder label.
